title: Battle of Huaqui
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Huaqui", at revision 1380857202, opens: "The Battle of Huaqui or Battle of Guaqui-modern spelling-, was a battle on June 20, 1811, 
between the Primera Junta's revolutionary troops and the royalist troops of the Viceroyalty of Peru on the border between Upper Peru,, resulting in a comprehensive defeat of the revolutionary armies." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2888833, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1811 battle of the Bolivian War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
